title: Section lengths align to 8- or 16-bar dance units
summary: Tango form skeletons use 8- or 16-bar section multiples (intro 4, A/B 16, coda 4–6); arbitrary bar counts break dance-floor recognisability and should not be randomised at L0.
engine_hint: Prefer golden_age_short / golden_age_standard forms; phrase_len=4 for tango, 8 for vals per M2 plan_phrases.
